messages:
Kai: Thinking of a retro speedrun & chill LAN next Tuesday in the lounge — old consoles welcome (SNES, N64, Dreamcast, GameCube) and any speedrun practice. Anyone up for low-key PB chasing? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Lina: Ill bring my N64 + a copy of Mario Kart 64. Also have four controllers if we need them.
Jon: I can dust off my Dreamcast and bring a couple of Sonic Adventure carts. Also willing to project a few runs.
Priya: If people want to practice TAS-style tricks, I can bring my capture card and an extra CRT for authenticity.
Sam: Love this. I'll run a small schedule so people can take 20-min practice blocks and then do showcase runs.
Kai: Plan: start at 6pm, quick setup till 6:30, then practice blocks 6:30-8:00, showcase runs 8:00-10:30. Sound good?
Lina: Works for me. Snacks? I can bring pretzels and some soda.
Jon: Heads up: bring adapters for component -> HDMI if you want to use the projector. I have two converters.
Priya: Also bring power strips and a surge protector. Last time a power brick was missing.
Sam: I'll post a sign-up sheet in #random for time slots and which console/game. Also can host remote viewers on Twitch if folks want to stream runs.
Kai: If streaming, check with the players before going live. Some people prefer private practice.
Lina: Suggestion: a casual bracket for best single-run times on Mario Kart items-only mode. Loser does a silly penalty (karaoke 1 song).
Jon: :laughing: Im in. Penalty accepted.
Priya: Can someone bring a portable battery for controllers? Old controllers sometimes die mid-run.
Sam: Ill bring AA batteries and a small solder kit for quick fixes.
game-night-bot: Reminder: keep noise reasonable after 10pm and follow office conduct. Please label your gear and remove personal items when you leave.
Kai: OK folks RSVP here with console + time slot preference. Ill finalize the schedule Monday evening. See you there!
